cohort: 43 pregnant women who tested positive for COVID-19 and presented to two New York City hospitals between March 13 and March 27, 2020
finding: A significant proportion of pregnant women with COVID-19 (32.6%) initially presented asymptomatically, with a majority (71.4%) developing symptoms during their admission or postpartum, and the overall disease severity in pregnant women was similar to that observed in non-pregnant adults.
